title: Virtualmin.com redesigned landing page released
summary: Hello, We’ve launched a new landing page for virtualmin.com. We redesigned it to be cleaner, simpler, and faster, with less visual clutter.
body_markdown:
I do agree with[@shoulders](https://forum.virtualmin.com/u/shoulders) on the points he mentioned, except the menu. If the three points in the middle are meant, I do think thats kind of the point to have those three there. But I would put the menu from the bottom to the top. When you get to the landing page, its at the bottom. If you scroll down, then its at the top. Just my personal preference, but it would look more fluent with the rest of the page.


That aside, it really does look great. Good job!
